h1:
9 Budget Hotels in Phichit
Real Value
We've Reviewed
heroSub: Nine low-budget stays in Phichit we've reviewed in depth, ranked by value, from around ฿437–700/night — from field-side houses with kitchens from ฿437 and a small city hotel a walk from Bueng Si Fai to a hotel by the Taphan Hin train station and a rice-field boutique with a pool in Bang Mun Nak. Every one from real guest reviews, with the honest pros and cons.
introH2: 🌳 Can you do Phichit on a small budget — and how do you pick a stay that's good value?
introHtml: Phichit is a small town where stays are already affordable — most of the province's rooms sit in the low hundreds to low thousands of baht. So this guide narrows it to the genuinely cheap, good-value picks, from around ฿437–700/night that we've reviewed in depth, then ranks them by value. The key to doing Phichit on a budget is to match your base to your plans, then weigh what your money actually buys you — the city centre (Sa Luang Road–Bueng Si Fai) puts the market, food and Bueng Si Fai within a walk, ideal if you have no car · the suburbs (Tha Luang–Khlong Khachen) get you bigger, quieter rooms with easy parking, but you'll need a car · and Taphan Hin, Bang Mun Nak and Wachira Barami are separate districts, about 25–45 minutes out, with their own draws — a hotel by the train station and field-side houses and resorts. Then weigh what you actually get: breakfast included, parking, a pool, or a kitchen to cook your own. This guide rounds up 9 budget stays in Phichit we've reviewed — each from reading real guest reviews, with the honest pros and cons, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Phichit has no metro; you get around by car, and the Northern Line railway stops at Phichit, Taphan Hin and Bang Mun Nak stations. Without a car, staying in the city centre or by the train station is easiest — the city centre has the market, restaurants and Bueng Si Fai within a walk or short drive, some walkable to the lake (Orchid Place, The Nest, Phichit Plaza) · by the station suits rail travellers (Roseinn in Taphan Hin) · and suburban and out-of-district stays almost all need a car, as dining around them is thin, but you get bigger, quieter rooms or a rice-field setting (Fahluang, Bed Hub, Modern Resort in the suburbs · Rice Country, SP Resort by the fields). The areas in this guide: City Centre — markets, food, Bueng Si Fai · Suburbs — big rooms, quiet, easy parking · Taphan Hin–Bang Mun Nak–Wachira Barami — by the train station, rice-field views, houses with kitchens.

entries.type: City Hotel 3-Star · big quiet rooms · Tha Luang, near Bueng Si Fai
entries.name: Fahluang Residence
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.6 · 29 reviews · top score in this set
entries.badge: 🏆 Best value in the set · top score 8.6
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Luang · Phichit city · ~1 km to Bueng Si Fai
tags: 🌳 Quiet, ~1 km to Bueng Si Fai
🚿 Strong rainfall hot water + strong Wi-Fi
entries.storyHtml: The best-value stay in this set also takes the top score — Fahluang Residence is a 3-star hotel in the Tha Luang area, scoring 8.6 from 29 reviews, from ฿580/night, about 1 km from Bueng Si Fai, under a 5-minute drive · Real reviews praise rooms larger than the price (standard ~24 sqm up to a 48 sqm VIP), many with private balconies, strong rainfall hot water, strong Wi-Fi, cleanliness and warm service beyond the price, plus generous parking and breakfast included · The honest caveats: it's not by the city-centre market, so without a car you'll lean on Grab, the breakfast has limited choice, and there's no pool · Best for drivers who prioritise big, quiet rooms and parking on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Many rooms have balconies but not all — request one when booking or at check-in. Some rooms have no tea/coffee set, so bring sachets if you need a morning cup. Bueng Si Fai is just ~1 km away — head out early to walk the park and watch the fish before breakfast.
pros: Top score in the set, 8.6 · rooms larger than the price, with balconies
Quiet setting, ~1 km to Bueng Si Fai
Friendly staff, service beyond the price · generous parking
Strong rainfall hot water · strong Wi-Fi · breakfast included
cons: Not in the city centre; without a car you'll lean on Grab

entries.type: Budget Hotel 3-Star · by the train station · Taphan Hin
entries.name: Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.3 · 15 reviews · by Taphan Hin station
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Taphan Hin district · ~1-min walk to the station (150 m)
tags: 🛏️ Big rooms, every room has a balcony
entries.addr: 57 Chom Thirawet Rd, Taphan Hin, Taphan Hin
entries.storyHtml: If you come to Phichit by train or for errands in Taphan Hin, this is the best-value, most on-point stay — Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin sits about 150 metres from Taphan Hin train station, a 1-minute walk, scoring 8.3 from 15 reviews, from ฿450/night · Real reviews praise rooms bigger and cleaner than the price, every room with a balcony, new aircon, strong hot water, a lift, and smiling staff, plus plenty of early-morning food around the station · The honest caveats: the building shows its age, corridors are fairly dark, some rooms have a musty smell or mosquitoes, and it's in Taphan Hin district, about 35–40 minutes from Phichit city · Best for Northern Line rail travellers and errand trips to Taphan Hin who want a value room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The station is just ~150 m away, perfect for Northern Line travellers. There's plenty of food and street carts around the station, especially early morning. Heading to Phichit city or Bueng Si Fai? Allow 35–40 minutes' drive. The front desk is open 24 hours for late arrivals.
pros: By Taphan Hin station, ~1-min walk — very convenient
Rooms bigger and cleaner than the price, all with balconies
Lift · free parking · free Wi-Fi · 24-hour front desk
Smiling staff · lots of early-morning food around the station
cons: Building shows its age, corridors fairly dark · some rooms musty/mosquitoes
In Taphan Hin district, 35–40 minutes from Phichit city

entries.type: City Hotel 3-Star · next to 7-Eleven · city centre
entries.name: The Nest Hotel Phichit
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sa Luang Rd · city centre · next to 7-Eleven
tags: 🏙️ City centre, walk to town shops
🍳 Clean rooms, rate often includes breakfast
entries.storyHtml: The most popular practical pick in the city centre — The Nest Hotel Phichit is a 3-star on Sa Luang Road, scoring 8.4 from 46 reviews, opened in 2016, from ฿650/night · What real reviews praise most is that it's right next to a 7-Eleven — water, snacks or essentials at any hour are a few steps away · It's a few minutes' drive from the market, train station and Bueng Si Fai, with clean rooms, comfy beds, upkeep better than expected, most rates including a made-to-order Thai breakfast for two, and friendly staff, plus it books directly on all 3 sites for easy price comparison · The honest caveats: cleanliness isn't always consistent across rooms, staff English is limited, and it's a small town so you'll need a car to explore · Best for overnight stays wanting a clean room in town beside a convenience store.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Many rates include a made-to-order Thai breakfast for two — pick one that does for better value. Cleanliness varies by room, so check the bathroom and bedding on arrival and ask to switch if it's not right; staff are flexible. Some rooms lack a hairdryer — ask at the front desk.
pros: Next to 7-Eleven, shop anytime · in the city centre
Clean rooms, comfy beds · most rates include breakfast for two
Free parking out front · 24-hour front desk
Friendly, helpful staff · books directly on all 3 sites
cons: Cleanliness not always consistent · limited staff English
Small town; main sights need a car

entries.type: Small City Hotel 3-Star · walk to Bueng Si Fai · city centre
entries.name: Orchid Place Hotel
entries.badge: 🚶 Walk to Bueng Si Fai · from ฿540
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sa Luang Rd · city centre · ~660 m walk to Bueng Si Fai
tags: ✨ Clean and quiet despite being central
📍 ~660 m to Bueng Si Fai, ~10-min walk to market
entries.addr: 24/115 Sa Luang Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit
entries.storyHtml: A budget city stay you can walk to Bueng Si Fai from — Orchid Place Hotel is a small 3-star on Sa Luang Road, scoring 8.0 from 28 reviews, from ฿540/night, about 660 metres from Bueng Si Fai and a 10-minute walk to the town market · Real reviews agree the rooms are clean and quiet despite the central location, with comfy beds, and there's free parking, free Wi-Fi, and fresh coffee with toast in the morning · The honest caveats: it's a small hotel with limited shared facilities, no pool, some rooms on the small side, and staff aren't on duty 24 hours, so call ahead for late arrivals · Best for errand trips and budget travellers who want to walk to Bueng Si Fai.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Bueng Si Fai is just ~660 m away — an easy walk, good in the morning or evening for the lakeside bird park. Breakfast is fresh coffee and toast, with reviews praising the coffee. It's a small property where staff aren't on duty round the clock, so call ahead with your arrival time if you'll be late.
pros: Clean and quiet rooms despite the central location
~660 m to Bueng Si Fai · ~10-min walk to the town market
Free parking and free Wi-Fi · coffee-and-toast breakfast
From ฿540, good value for budget travellers
cons: Small hotel, limited facilities · no pool
Some rooms on the small side · staff not on duty 24 hours

entries.type: Budget Hotel 2-Star · big rooms · Khlong Khachen
entries.name: Bed Hub Hotel Phichit
entries.badge: 🛏️ Big rooms for the price · from ฿550
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Khachen · Phichit city · ~4 km from the centre
tags: 🛏️ Big rooms for the price, minimalist design
entries.storyHtml: One of the most-praised budget stays in Phichit for big, value rooms — Bed Hub Hotel Phichit is a small two-storey building with a garden in the Khlong Khachen area, scoring 8.0 from 12 reviews (TripAdvisor 4/5), from ฿550/night · Real reviews praise rooms bigger than expected, big beds, a clean, modern minimalist dark-grey design, garden-view balconies, strong, wide Wi-Fi, generous parking, and free hot pork congee at breakfast · The honest caveats: it's about 4 km from the city centre with few shops nearby, no full restaurant, and occasional housekeeping noise mid-morning · Best for road-trippers and errand stays who want a value room and strong Wi-Fi.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's about 4 km out of town on a main road with easy access and generous parking — driving yourself is easiest. Rooms have garden-view balconies; ask for an upper floor for a better view and more quiet. Shops nearby are few, so stop at the close 7-Eleven or order delivery. The strong Wi-Fi makes working online easy.
pros: Big rooms for the price, clean modern minimalist design
Strong, wide Wi-Fi · generous parking
Free pork-congee breakfast · garden-view balconies
From ฿550, better value than many budget stays in the province
cons: About 4 km from the centre, few shops nearby; needs a car
No full restaurant · occasional housekeeping noise mid-morning

entries.type: House with Kitchen 3-Star · by the fields · Wachira Barami
entries.name: SP Resort and Garden
entries.badge: 💸 Cheapest in the set ฿437 · with a kitchen
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Wachira Barami district · Route 115 · ~25 min from the city
tags: 🌾 Green garden, quiet by the fields
🚗 Park at your door · open 24 hours
entries.storyHtml: The cheapest stay in this set, with house-style rooms that have kitchens — SP Resort and Garden starts from just ฿437/night, scoring 8.0 from 24 reviews, on Route 115 in the Wachira Barami area, a quiet rice-field zone outside the city · Real reviews praise rooms cleaner than the price, a kind owner, a quiet garden setting, and detached/duplex houses with kitchens, fridges, sofas and TVs — good for cooking your own meals or long stays, with monthly rentals available · The honest caveats: it's about 25 minutes from the city so a car is essential, there's no restaurant, breakfast or pool on site, and online reviews are still few · Best for drivers wanting a private, quiet house to self-cater or stay long on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The rooms have a small kitchen and fridge — stop at the market or a convenience store before checking in to cook your own cheap meals. It's on Route 115 outside town with no restaurants walkable, so driving is easiest. Staying long? Ask about monthly rates. Reviews are few, so message or call the resort about room condition and prices before you go.
pros: Cheapest in the set from ฿437 · house-style rooms with kitchens
Cleaner than the price · quiet garden setting
Pet-friendly · monthly rental available · open 24 hours
Park at your door, good for long stays
cons: About 25 minutes from the city, awkward without a car

entries.type: Boutique Resort 3-Star · rice-field views, pool · Bang Mun Nak
entries.name: Rice Country Village
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.3 · 51 reviews · most reviews in this set
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Mun Nak district · Ho Krai · ~45 min from the city
tags: 🌾 Old rice mill turned boutique resort
🏞️ Villa rooms with balconies, rice-field views
☕ On-site Rice Country Cafe · free parking
entries.addr: 109 Moo 8, Ho Krai, Bang Mun Nak
entries.storyHtml: The stay with a story and the most reviews in this set at 51 — Rice Country Village is a boutique resort where the owners turned the family's old rice mill into a stay and cafe, scoring 8.3, from ฿700/night, set among rice fields in Bang Mun Nak district · Real reviews praise the quiet, the lovely rice-field views, small villa rooms with private balconies, and the highlight — an outdoor pool with a slide, rare in a small district — plus a Rice Country Cafe for coffee over the fields · The honest caveats: it's in the south of the province, about 45 minutes from Phichit city, with no in-room breakfast and limited restaurants nearby · Best for couples and families set on a rural getaway who want a pool on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Many rooms look out over the rice fields — request a field-view room for the morning coffee spot reviewers love most. Check the cafe's opening hours and keep a meal plan in mind, as restaurants around Bang Mun Nak are limited. Rooms are few and it's family-run, so book ahead on long weekends.
pros: A stay with a story, from an old rice mill — unlike any hotel block
Villa rooms with balconies and rice-field views, quiet
Outdoor pool with a slide, good for families
On-site cafe with good coffee · attentive owner · free parking
cons: Far from Phichit city, about 45 minutes; needs a car
No in-room breakfast · limited restaurants nearby

entries.type: City Resort 3-Star · newly built, park at door · Khlong Khachen
entries.name: Modern Resort Phichit
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Khachen · Phichit city · ~10 min from the market
entries.storyHtml: A small resort built in 2019 whose selling point is new, clean, quiet rooms with parking at your door — Modern Resort Phichit is a single-storey, 16-room resort in the Khlong Khachen area of Phichit city, scoring 8.2 from 10 reviews, from ฿700/night · Real reviews put cleanliness first, plus a quiet, private feel and door-front parking that makes unloading easy and keeps the car nearby; rooms have all the basics and breakfast is served · The honest caveats: the bathrooms are fairly small, rooms are just right-sized, beds are firm, breakfast is simple, the 16 rooms fill fast on holidays, and it's in the suburbs · Best for drivers wanting a new, clean, quiet room with easy parking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: It's in the suburban Khlong Khachen area with door-front parking, but without a car getting into town is awkward, so driving yourself is easiest. One review noted the breakfast count didn't match the booking — confirm how many breakfasts you get at check-in. With only 16 rooms, book ahead on long weekends.
pros: Small resort built 2019, clean rooms — praised often
Park right at your door, very handy for drivers
Quiet and private, 16 rooms, never crowded
Rooms well-equipped, breakfast served · 24-hour front desk
cons: Bathrooms fairly small · firm beds · simple breakfast
In the suburbs, you'll drive into town · 16 rooms fill fast

entries.type: City Hotel 3-Star · with a pool · city centre
entries.name: Phichit Plaza Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sa Luang Rd · city centre · opposite Si Suk Hospital
tags: 🏊 Has a pool, rare for a budget central stay
🛏️ Spacious rooms, comfy beds, strong shower
🏙️ City centre, walk to the market
entries.addr: 9 Sa Luang Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Phichit
entries.storyHtml: We close the set with a stay that gives you a city-centre pool on a budget — Phichit Plaza Hotel is a 90-room high-rise on Sa Luang Road, opposite Si Suk Hospital, within walking distance of the town market, scoring 7.6 from 24 reviews, from ฿650/night · Real reviews praise rooms bigger than expected, comfy beds, a strong shower, a pool for the kids, and friendly staff · To be clear, the building is ageing, upkeep isn't thorough, the pool is sometimes cloudy and unattended, some showers leak, Wi-Fi is weak in some rooms, and the corridors/lift have no AC (we placed it last for the lowest score in the set and the building's condition) · Best for families who want a pool and big central rooms on a budget and can accept an older building.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high floor (6th and up) — quieter, away from the ground-floor karaoke, and usually in better condition. If you're here to swim, check the pool's condition on arrival, as it's sometimes cloudy. Some showers leak — run the water on arrival and ask to switch rooms if it's not right.
pros: City-centre pool, rare on a budget
Bigger rooms than the small in-town hotels, comfy beds
Central location, walk to the market · opposite Si Suk Hospital
90 rooms, lift · friendly staff · parking
cons: Ageing building, upkeep not thorough · pool sometimes cloudy
Some showers leak · weak Wi-Fi in some rooms · hot corridors/lift

adviceTitle: How to pick a budget stay in Phichit that fits your trip

advice.head: Tightest budget, want the best value
advice.bodyHtml: → SP Resort and Garden ฿437, houses with in-room kitchens, cheapest in the set, monthly rental · or Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin ฿450, a 8.3 hotel a 1-minute walk from Taphan Hin station · or Orchid Place Hotel ฿540, central, a walk from Bueng Si Fai

advice.head: Central base, easy to explore on foot, no car
advice.bodyHtml: → The Nest Hotel Phichit ฿650, next to a 7-Eleven, central, books on all 3 sites · or Orchid Place Hotel ฿540, ~660 m to Bueng Si Fai, clean and quiet · or Phichit Plaza ฿650, central with a pool

advice.head: Want big, quiet rooms that are good value
advice.bodyHtml: → Fahluang Residence ฿580, big 24–48 sqm rooms, top score in the set · or Bed Hub Hotel ฿550, big rooms for the price with strong Wi-Fi · or Modern Resort ฿700, newly built, park at your door

advice.head: Travelling by train to Taphan Hin
advice.bodyHtml: → Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin ฿450, ~1-min walk to Taphan Hin station, every room with a balcony — step off the train and walk straight in

advice.head: Want a rural, rice-field setting
advice.bodyHtml: → Rice Country Village ฿700, old rice mill turned boutique resort, rice-field views, pool slide, in Bang Mun Nak · or SP Resort and Garden ฿437, field-side houses with kitchens in Wachira Barami, quiet

advice.head: Want a pool on a budget
advice.bodyHtml: → Phichit Plaza Hotel ฿650, a city-centre pool the kids can use · or Rice Country Village ฿700, a pool with a slide and rice-field views in Bang Mun Nak

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate from-rates for standard rooms outside peak season and can change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking · The scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on the booking platforms; we did not stay in person · Every stay here is a budget 2–3 star property, so they come with trade-offs — some have no pool, some sit on the edge of town or out in the districts rather than within walking distance of the sights, and some are older buildings, so please read each stay's caveats before booking · On price comparison: Fahluang, The Nest and Phichit Plaza book directly across all 3 sites (Agoda/Booking/Trip.com) · Roseinn, Orchid Place, Rice Country and Modern Resort book directly on Agoda and Trip.com · Bed Hub and SP Resort book directly on Agoda — so those two can't be price-compared across all 3 sites · Phichit has no metro; suburban and out-of-district stays (Taphan Hin, Bang Mun Nak, Wachira Barami) are almost all far easier with a car · Small properties like the garden resort and the field-side houses fill fast on long weekends, so book ahead · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about budget stays in Phichit

faq.q: ❓ What's the best-value budget stay in Phichit?
faq.a: By value (score per baht), Fahluang Residence ฿580, scoring 8.6, is the best value in this set — it takes the top score and gives rooms larger than the price · For the cheapest, SP Resort and Garden ฿437 (houses with kitchens) and Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin ฿450 (a 8.3 hotel a walk from the station) are strong value · For a central base you can walk from, Orchid Place ฿540 is close to Bueng Si Fai.

faq.q: ❓ How much do budget stays in Phichit cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start from around ฿437–700 per night · At the cheap end: SP Resort from ฿437 (houses with kitchens), Roseinn ฿450, Orchid Place ฿540, Bed Hub ฿550 · From ฿580–700: Fahluang ฿580, The Nest ฿650, Phichit Plaza ฿650, Rice Country and Modern Resort ฿700 · All are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season; long weekends push them up and small properties fill fast.

faq.q: ❓ On a budget but want a central base to explore on foot — where should I stay?
faq.a: Phichit has no metro, so without a car, a stay around Sa Luang Road–Bueng Si Fai is easiest — Orchid Place Hotel ฿540 is about 660 metres from Bueng Si Fai and a 10-minute walk to the market · The Nest Hotel ฿650 is next to a 7-Eleven in the centre for anytime shopping · Phichit Plaza ฿650 is central and has a pool · All three are in town, a walk or short drive from the main sights.

faq.q: ❓ Are there budget stays in Phichit with a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes · Phichit Plaza Hotel ฿650 has a pool right in the city centre, rare on a budget (though it's an older building and the pool is sometimes cloudy, so check its condition on arrival) · and Rice Country Village ฿700 in Bang Mun Nak has an outdoor pool with a slide and rice-field views, good for families · The cheaper stays mostly have no pool and lean on location and rooms instead.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Phichit by train — where should I stay on a budget?
faq.a: Phichit's Northern Line passes several stations · If you alight at Taphan Hin, Roseinn Hotel Taphanhin ฿450 is about a 1-minute walk (150 m) — the handiest, and every room has a balcony · If you alight at Phichit city station, central hotels like The Nest or Orchid Place are about a 6–7 minute drive from the station, a few minutes by onward ride.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking budget stays in Phichit?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary with each period's promotions, so open and compare all 3 before booking · Fahluang, The Nest and Phichit Plaza book directly on all 3 sites · Roseinn, Orchid Place, Rice Country and Modern Resort book on Agoda and Trip.com · Bed Hub and SP Resort book on Agoda · Each review page has the full set of price-comparison links, which can save you tens to hundreds of baht a night.
